ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT AGREEMENT made as of this  day of Wovewber. 2015 (this "Agreement"), by and between SCHUMAN 673/14 LLC, a New York Limited Liability Company having an address at 36-04 Skillman Avenue, Long Island City ("Owner"), and SCHUMAN 673/16 LLC, a New York Limited Liability Company having an address at 36-04 Skillman Avenue, Long Island City ("Developer"). RECITALS: A. Owner is the owner in fee title of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, known as 34-23 Steinway Street, Queens, New York, and identified on the Tax Map of the City of New York, County of Queens (the "Tax Map") as Block 673, Lot 14, which is more particularly described in Exhibit A annexed hereto (said land being herein called "Owner's Land"; said buildings and improvements, together with any future replacements, additions or alterations thereto permitted pursuant to the provisions of this Agreement being referred to hereinafter collectively as "Owner's Building"; Owner's Land and Owner's Building, collectively,"Owner's Parcel"). B. Developer is the owner in fee title of certain lands located at 34-01 Steinway Street and 40-50 34th Avenue, Queens New York, and identified on the Tax Map as Block 673, Lots 16 and 25, which is more particularly described in Exhibit B annexed hereto (said land being herein called "Developer's Land"; and said existing buidings and improvements thereon being herein referred to,as "Developer's Existing Building"). C. Owner's Land and Developer's Land are contiguous along a shared property line for a distanceinexcessof10linearfeet. Developer may desire in the future to enlarge Developer's Existing Building or demolish Developer's Existing Building and construct a new buiding or buildings on a development site and to construct other improvements associated with such new building or buildings (said enlargement or newbuilding or buildings and improvements, together with any further replacements thereof or additions thereto not prohibited by the provisions of this Agreement,being herein referred to collectively as the "New Building"; Developer's Existing Building, the New Building and any and all building and improvements now or hereafter located on Developer's Land and/or any Additional Parcels being herein Rights than would be permitted on the Developer's Land if considered as a single zoning lot (as hereinafter defined) under the Zoning Resolution (as hereinafter defined). E. To enable Developer to construct the New Building,Owner and Developer wish to take advantage of the procedure authorized by the Zoning Resolution that permits them to merge their separate of Development Rights from Owner's Land to Developer's Land. G.
